description.zh: 指定修改后主机的备注信息，最多支持500字符。
description.en: The new description of the host. The description can be up to 500 characters in length.

description.zh:
指定要修改的主机ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to query the ID of the host.

description.zh: 指定修改后主机的名称，最多支持128字符。
description.en: The new name of the host. The name can be up to 128 characters.

description.zh: 指定修改后主机的私网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
description.en: The new internal endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address.

description.zh: 指定修改后主机的公网地址，可使用域名或IP地址。
description.en: The new public endpoint of the host. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address.

description.zh:
指定要修改的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
指定修改后主机所属的网络域ID。
> 您可以调用[ListNetworkDomains ](~~2758827~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the new network domain to which the host belongs.

> You can call the [ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~) operation to query the network domain ID.

description.zh:
指定修改后主机的操作系统类型。取值：
- **Linux**
- **Windows**
description.en:
The new operating system of the host. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

description.zh:
主机首选密钥交换算法配置。当OSType取值为Linux时，可以修改本参数。取值： 

- **default**：默认模式
- **diffie-hellman-group1-sha1**：diffie-hellman-group1-sha1算法兼容模式
- **diffie-hellman-group14-sha1**：diffie-hellman-group14-sha1算法兼容模式
- **diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1**：diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1算法兼容模式
description.en:
The preferred key exchange algorithm of the host. If you set OSType to Linux, you can modify this parameter. Valid values:

- **default**

- **diffie-hellman-group1-sha1**

- **diffie-hellman-group14-sha1**

- **diffie-hellman-group-exchange-sha1**

description.zh:
指定要修改的主机所在堡垒机的区域ID。
> Region ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to modify the information about the host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

descriptions.zh:
该接口支持修改本地主机、ECS主机、RDS专属集群主机的基本信息。
> 如果您修改了ECS主机或RDS专属集群主机的基本信息，由于堡垒机系统会定期同步ECS主机、RDS专属集群主机的基本信息，修改结果可能会被ECS主机或RDS专属集群主机所同步的基本信息覆盖。
descriptions.en:
You can call the ModifyHost operation to modify the basic information about a host in a data center, an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance, or a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster.

> The basic information about ECS instances and hosts in ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated clusters within your Alibaba Cloud account is synchronized to Bastionhost on a regular basis. After you modify the basic information about an ECS instance or a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster, the modification result may be overwritten by the synchronized information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost modify-host --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --host-private-address 193.168.XX.XX --host-public-address 200.1.XX.XX --os-type Linux --host-name TestHost --comment Host_for_test. --network-domain-id 1 --pref-kex default --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ModifyHost --region cn-hangzhou --Comment 'Host_for_test.' --PrefKex default --HostPrivateAddress '193.168.XX.XX' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --HostPublicAddress '200.1.XX.XX' --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1 --HostName TestHost --NetworkDomainId 1
